messages.subject: Project Solstice - Legal Due Diligence Report
messages.plaintextBody:
Geraldine, Daniel,

Please find our legal due diligence report attached. Key points to highlight: the core patent is not yet granted (US office action outstanding), and the University of Cambridge sponsored research agreement is the principal IP dependency - both flagged and to be qualified by the disclosure letter. No material litigation. We think the matter is in good shape for completion.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1190
